notes: NEW Plugins: add new effects, instruments and Sky Synth sound packs from small .skyplugin files (File > Plugins). Ten plugins are included: Ring Mod, Auto Wah, Tape Wobble, Exciter, Trance Gate, Glass Harp, FM Marimba, Rubber Pluck and two sound packs
Songs carry the plugins they use, so they open anywhere (Sky Studio asks before installing them)
NEW Web version: runs in Chrome or Edge from a web page, saves and opens your songs as files, keeps a recovery copy, and updates itself with a Reload & update card
Plugin effects run in a sandbox on the audio thread and plugin instruments in a background worker - they can't read your files or use the internet
Piano roll clicks stay accurate right after the roll scrolls
